text: [ERR_RST] Connection dropped. PCAP analysis confirms external sever. Someone cut the cord on Banshee's dive. This wasn't hostile ICE. It was an inside job.
FWD: FWD: Asset Cleanup. "Tell the cleaners to bill it under 'Server Maintenance'. And scrub the transit logs for those three runners. I don't want a paper trail."
Slack Export - Channel: #net-sec. @devin: "Stop spamming the DECRYPT tool on the outer perimeter. It's redlining the physical heat sensors on your rigs. Do it again and I'm revoking your access."
Recovered Audio Fragment: "...they knew we were coming. Vanguard, if you're hearing this, burn your rig. They have our IPs. They're taking us to the old— [STATIC]"
Invoice #8849-B: 'Sedatives, Class 4. Qty: 3.' Delivery destination: OMNI-CORP SUB-LEVEL 4 (Defunct Metro line).
Memo - ICE Protocol Update. "Once a hostile trace hits 80%, the system now auto-accelerates. The window to disconnect closes to seconds. If they don't pack up before 80, we own them."
Automated ping. Handshake failed. Metadata attached: 'Vanguard, it's Cipher. Trench is hurt. They have us in a Faraday cage under the city. Need an exit strategy.'
Direct Message - @k.osborne: "The Faraday cage is holding, but the internal firewall is a beast. 130 HP minimum. Don't even try brute forcing with a standard Scan."
Terminal Log: Internal breach attempt detected. User: Cipher. "Can't bypass without an upgraded payload. Need more RAM to cycle tools faster. Vanguard, hope you're farming intel out there."
Routing table decrypted. The dummy corp is 'Apex Logistics'. Following the traffic... it all funnels into a single, massive localized server. The Tartarus Node.
[SYSTEM ALERT] TARGET ACQUIRED. // NODE: TARTARUS. // IP SECURED. They are holding them behind this wall. This is a one-way trip. Time to break them out.
